metadata.bio: Audio Engineering, DSP Tools, Sound Design & Music Production

vst_dsp.title: Saturnine Tube Drive & Wavefolder
vst_dsp.subtitle: Asymmetric Polyphonic Distortion & Harmonic Saturator
vst_dsp.description: Custom dual-stage saturation plugin featuring tube triode emulation, diode clipping curves, and a West-Coast style folded wave shaper with oversampling anti-aliasing.
specs: Iterative nonlinear solver with 4x polynomial anti-aliasing (Bilinear Transform)
Zero-latency DC-blocking Butterworth highpass filter stage
Dry/Wet parallel blend with automatic gain compensation (RMS matched)

vst_dsp.title: VocalMorph RVC Real-Time Voice Pipeline
vst_dsp.subtitle: Low-Latency Neural Voice Conversion & Formant Resynthesis
vst_dsp.description: Production-grade automated Python pipeline leveraging Retrieval-based Voice Conversion (RVC v2) with pitch extraction via Harvest/CREPE and real-time ASIO audio streaming.
specs: End-to-end roundtrip latency tuned under 18ms using PyTorch TorchScript JIT
Continuous f0 trajectory smoothing with intelligent de-jitter gate
Custom timbre feature index retrieval with dynamic nearest-neighbor blend

vst_dsp.title: ResoComb Multi-Band Resonator
vst_dsp.subtitle: Tuned Delay Matrix & Physical Modeling Synthesizer
vst_dsp.description: Feedback comb filtering network capable of morphing static percussive noise bursts into metallic plates, strings, and tuned acoustic bodies with microtonal scale tuning.
specs: 8-voice fractional delay lines with Hermite polynomial interpolation
Integrated multi-pole damping damping filters inside the feedback loop
MIDI-mappable keyboard tracking for harmonic Karplus-Strong string synthesis

vst_dsp.title: StereoFlux M/S Spatial Expander
vst_dsp.subtitle: Psychoacoustic Mid-Side Processor & Haas Delay
vst_dsp.description: Clean stereo bus width enhancer that maintains strict mono-compatibility. Combines frequency-split mid/side gain trim with cross-channel phase decorrelation.
specs: Linear-phase crossover filter dividing Sub (mono-summed) and High-Band expansion
Integrated goniometer phase correlation metering (-1.0 to +1.0)

projects.title: Apex Protocol: Mech Combat Sound Reel
projects.description: Complete sound redesign for a sci-fi bipedal mech encounter. Layered modular servo actuators, hydraulic hiss, heavy titanium footfalls, plasma cannon charges, and reactive damage stinger transients.

projects.title: Aethelgard: Elemental Magic & Ambient Ecosystem
projects.description: Procedural magic cast audio assets and spatialized dynamic ambience. Designed using organic acoustic field recordings (ice cracking, fire torches, wind tunnels) combined with spectral granular synthesis.

projects.title: Overdrive 2088: 3D Animation Cinematic Short
projects.description: Linear cinematic audio overhaul for a high-speed cyberpunk hoverbike pursuit. Features Doppler-shifted turbine roars, pneumatic brake squeals, sub-bass pulse impacts, and holographic HUD telemetry beeps.
